name: Multi-channel Surface Voxelization
definition: A technique to generate a uniform spatial partitioning structure (voxel grid) in real-time on the GPU, storing multiple attributes per voxel.
summary: Multi-channel Surface Voxelization is a real-time GPU technique that rasterizes 3D geometry into a voxel grid while simultaneously storing multiple surface attributes per voxel, distinguishing itself by supporting partial occupancy and transparency in a single pass.
